Class IntIntMap

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.fast.collect.IntIntMap
public final class IntIntMap extends Object
A hash map from int keys to int values, which stores both without boxing them.

Every key is allowed, 0 included. Where Map returns null, this map returns its missing value, set when it is created: get(int) for a key it does not contain, and put(int, int) and remove(int) when the key had no value before. The missing value is 0 unless the map is created with another one, and it can be stored as any other value: containsKey(int) tells the two apart.

Its entries are walked with a IntIntMap.Cursor rather than an iterator, which would box them: 

for (var cursor = map.cursor(); cursor.next(); ) {
    if (cursor.value() < 0) {
        cursor.remove();
    }
}

Each entry is kept in one long of an array, its key and its value together, at a slot that a multiplicative hash of the key picks; a key that finds its slot taken goes to the next free one. The map grows, doubling its capacity, when its entries would fill more than its load factor of the slots, 0.5 unless it is created with another one. A lower load factor makes lookups faster and takes more memory. The map never shrinks, and holds at most 2^30 times its load factor entries.

The order of the entries is unspecified, and changes when the map grows. The map is not thread-safe. While a cursor walks it, or while forEach(IntIntConsumer) or removeIf(IntIntPredicate) runs, changing the map other than through the cursor or removeIf has unspecified results: there is no check for it.

Since:
0.2.0

      public IntIntMap()
      Creates a map with room for 16 entries, the missing value 0 and the load factor 0.5.

    • IntIntMap

      public IntIntMap(int expectedSize)
      Creates a map with room for a number of entries, the missing value 0 and the load factor 0.5.
      Parameters:
      expectedSize - the number of entries the map holds before it grows
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if expectedSize is negative or larger than the map can ever hold

    • IntIntMap

      public IntIntMap(int expectedSize, int missingValue)
      Creates a map with room for a number of entries, a missing value and the load factor 0.5.
      Parameters:
      expectedSize - the number of entries the map holds before it grows
      missingValue - the value returned for keys the map does not contain
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if expectedSize is negative or larger than the map can ever hold

    • IntIntMap

      public IntIntMap(int expectedSize, int missingValue, float loadFactor)
      Creates a map with room for a number of entries, a missing value and a load factor.
      Parameters:
      expectedSize - the number of entries the map holds before it grows
      missingValue - the value returned for keys the map does not contain
      loadFactor - the share of its slots the map fills before it grows
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if loadFactor is not greater than 0 and less than 1, or if expectedSize is negative or larger than the map can ever hold with that load factor
